text: {"assertions":["A message redelivery bug was fixed in worker/queue/consumer.py for background jobs that only occurred for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was the serialiser dropping fields it did not recognize, causing the same message id to be handled more than once.","The fix implemented a strict schema rejecting unknown fields via PR #1549 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1.","The bug could be reproduced by killing the worker mid-batch and restarting it.","The fix was covered by tests in tests/worker/test_consumer.py.","The backlog cleared 32 minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
